errors.photosDenied: Photos access is off for JoyoFit. Turn it on in Settings.

photosDialog.title: Photos access
photosDialog.instagram: Instagram opens an image from your photo library, so JoyoFit saves this one there first. Your phone asks for permission next.
photosDialog.save: JoyoFit adds this image to your photos. It does not read the photos you already have. Your phone asks for permission next.

strava.title: Strava
strava.connectHint: Connect Strava to send this workout with its distance, calories, heart rate and route.

statuses.failed: Could not be sent, try again

strava.downloading: Still downloading from the watch. Send after the next sync.
strava.signIn: Sign in with JoyoRogo (More, Health and cloud) to send.
strava.fileHint: You can also save the .fit file from the Export card above and upload it at strava.com → Upload activity.

fitImport.duplicate: Already imported: {{sport}} on {{when}} is in your workouts, so nothing was added.
fitImport.overlap: Your watch already recorded this workout ({{sport}}, {{when}}), so the file was not imported. The watch's workout is kept.
fitImport.tooLarge: This file is too large to be a FIT activity.

errors.notFit: This is not a FIT file. Pick the .fit file your bike computer recorded.
errors.checksum: This FIT file is damaged or was cut short (its checksum does not match).
errors.unreadable: This FIT file could not be read; it looks damaged.
errors.notActivity: This is a FIT {{type}} file, not an activity file. Pick the file of a recorded ride or run.
errors.noSession: This FIT file has no activity session (no totals for a ride or run), so there is nothing to import.
errors.noStart: This FIT file has no real start time (the device had no clock set), so it cannot be placed in your history.
errors.noDuration: This FIT file has no duration, so there is nothing to import.

live.title: Live workout
live.emptyDescription: Outdoor walks, runs and rides started on the watch open here. Indoors, start on the watch, then tap Start.

status.searching: Waiting for the start on the watch…
status.preparing: Waiting for the start on the watch

live.searchingHint: The workout has not started. The timer begins once the watch has GPS and the workout is really running on the watch.

endPrompt.title: The watch seems to have stopped
endPrompt.body: The watch reports no workout running but has not confirmed it finished. End this live workout?

burned.title: Burned so far
burned.fuel: Right now {{fat}}% from fat, {{carbs}}% from carbs

calc.title: How is this calculated?
calc.watch: An estimate by JoyoFit, the watch does not measure it: each calorie is split by your heart rate at that moment, with a maximum of {{max}} bpm (220 minus your age from the profile). Easier effort burns a larger share of fat.
calc.phone: An estimate by JoyoFit, the watch does not measure it: each calorie is split by your heart rate at that moment, with a maximum of {{max}} bpm (220 minus your age from the profile). Easier effort burns a larger share of fat. The watch sends no live calories to JoyoFit, so they too come from its live heart rate, your weight, age and sex (Keytel 2005); the watch screen may differ.

more.title: More
more.waiting: Waiting for the first numbers from the watch.
more.ended: The full record (route, splits, heart-rate chart) arrives with the next sync and appears under Workouts.

sport.inferred: The watch asked for GPS, so this looks like an outdoor workout. Which one is it?

map.waiting: Waiting for the phone’s GPS position

route.title: Route on the map
route.empty: No saved routes yet. Import a GPX file under Routes to draw it here.
